presentation.summary: Zero-storage virtual playback backed by dynamic streaming provider resolution.
presentation.description_markdown: Registers and resolves host-managed `virtual://` virtual media through Silo's authenticated plugin control plane, without database credentials or stored media files.
presentation.setup_markdown: Before enabling the request integration, enter the complete secret streaming provider manifest URL and pick one Movies library and one Series library from the host’s library list. Add an optional TMDB token for authoritative worldwide digital/physical release gating. No database URL or media path is required.

fields.label: Movies Library
fields.description: Destination Silo Movies library. Need one? Create it at [Settings -> Libraries](/admin/libraries) and use the "Add Virtual" button on the Folders tab — no local storage required.

fields.label: Series Library
fields.description: Destination Silo Series library. Need one? Create it at [Settings -> Libraries](/admin/libraries) and use the "Add Virtual" button on the Folders tab — no local storage required.

fields.label: Manifest URL
fields.description: Full streaming provider manifest URL (e.g. AIOStreams, StreamNZB, or any Stremio-compatible addon). Must include the full tokenized path ending in /manifest.json.

fields.label: Allow local HTTP
fields.description: Allow plain HTTP only for localhost, .local, single-label Docker/service names, or private IPs. HTTPS remains the default.

fields.label: Candidate Cache TTL (minutes)
fields.description: How long stream candidates are cached before re-fetching from the provider (1–10080 minutes). Lower = fresher results, higher = faster playback.

fields.label: Prowlarr URL
fields.description: Optional Prowlarr base URL for release monitoring. If Silo and Prowlarr run in Docker on the same host, use the container name (e.g. http://prowlarr:9696) to bypass auth gates. Leave blank to skip release monitoring.

fields.label: Prowlarr API Key
fields.description: API key for your Prowlarr instance. Leave blank if not required.

fields.label: Search Check Interval (minutes)
fields.description: How often to check Prowlarr for new releases (minimum 15 minutes, maximum 1 week).

fields.label: TMDB API Token
fields.description: TMDB API key (v3) or bearer token (v4) for accurate release-date detection. Without it, movies use a conservative 90-day theatrical window.

fields.label: Monitored Queue File
fields.description: File path for persisting the monitored media queue. Defaults to .silo-virtual-library-monitored.json in the plugin work directory.

fields.label: Prowlarr Release Index File
fields.description: Optional local rolling index for the one-request Prowlarr feed. Entries expire after 14 days; registered Silo media is not affected.

fields.label: Enable Quality Profiles
fields.description: Enable quality-based stream filtering. Each media gets a profile picker during playback.

fields.label: Quality Profile Preset
fields.description: Choose a starting profile set. Custom keeps the JSON editor below available for advanced matching.

fields.label: Quality Profiles
fields.description: One profile per label. Fields: label (required), resolution (2160p/1080p/720p/480p), hdr, exclude_hdr (use * to require SDR), codec_video, codec_audio, include_regex, exclude_regex, preferred_order.

fields.label: Fallback to Any Stream
fields.description: Return 1 stream if no profiles match.
